description: Change a library entry's name, description, category and/or public display (at least one); omitted fields keep their value and no version is created. `description: ""` clears the description, and a given `category` replaces the current one. Public display shows the entry's name, description and category and the full content of its agents, skills with their bundle files, rules and plugin files on the open web, without an account, where search engines can index them. Its MCP server configuration is public too: anyone can install the entry, MCP servers included, without an account with `npx @athenode/cli use <slug>`, so MCP values must stay ${VAR} references. After it is turned off, the entry can stay on the public site for up to a day and longer in search engines' caches. So `publicDisplay: true` needs `confirmPublic: true`, even when the entry already has it on, and is refused without it before anything is sent; ask the user specifically about public display before setting it. `publicDisplay: false` needs no confirmation. Turning it on for an entry an administrator excluded from the public site is refused with code `library_public_display_banned`. Allowed for those who may manage the entry. `entry` is the entry's exact name (matched case-insensitively, surrounding spaces ignored), or its id with `byId: true`; a value that looks like an id is still taken as a name without `byId`.

byId.description: `entry` is an entry id, not a name (CLI: --by-id).

category.description: The entry's new category (CLI: --category); kept when omitted. One of: programming, testing-qa, security, devops, design, productivity, other.

confirmPublic.description: Confirms turning public display on (CLI: --confirm-public); required with `publicDisplay: true`, no change by itself. Publishing makes the plugin's agents, skills, MCP servers, files and rules visible to every signed-in Athenode user and turns the entry's public display on, unless an administrator made public display unavailable for the entry. Public display shows the entry's name, description and category and the full content of its agents, skills with their bundle files, rules and plugin files on the open web, without an account, where search engines can index them. Its MCP server configuration is public too: anyone can install the entry, MCP servers included, without an account with `npx @athenode/cli use <slug>`, so MCP values must stay ${VAR} references. After it is turned off, the entry can stay on the public site for up to a day and longer in search engines' caches.

entry.description: Library entry name, or its id with byId.

publicDisplay.description: Turns public display on (`true`, which needs `confirmPublic: true`) or off (`false`); omitted, the entry keeps its setting. Unlike `confirmPublic: false`, which equals an omitted one, `false` is a change (CLI: --public-display / --no-public-display).
